    stream_context_create(json_decode('{"a":1}'));
    php:    TypeError: ... must be of type ?array, stdClass given
    elephc: accepted, and the program continued with an empty context

Both auditors that reviewed the previous commit named this same arm, independently, and both were
right. It was the last shape of `?array` that did not match php: the scalar ladder raised, null was
accepted, an array was accepted — and an object fell off the end into "no options".

The asymmetry is the part that mattered. php
